summary: Fixed TUI-only Pi extensions (ui-customization, git-info, model-info) appearing in Gizmo settings by introducing a `filterGizmoCompatiblePiExtensions` helper and routing the resource catalog through it, then restarted the dev server.
decisions: Route extension enumeration in the resource catalog through a new `filterGizmoCompatiblePiExtensions` helper instead of the unfiltered `listPiExtensions`, so TUI-only extensions (runtime: "tui") are excluded from settings UI.
Reuse `enabledPiExtensionPaths` over the new filtered list so session loading also skips TUI-only extensions consistently.
errors: Prettier --check failed on the edited pi-global-resources.ts because of formatting drift; resolved by running `prettier --write` and re-checking, after which it passed.
